Kurz.schwierig: +5 feet per square, can't Step into it
Kurz.sehr: +10 feet per square, can't Step into it
Kurz.gefahr: moving through it deals damage; the terrain sets type and amount
Kurz.schmal: Balance, Off-Guard; when hit or on a failed save, Reflex save or you fall
Kurz.uneben: Balance, Off-Guard; when hit or on a failed save, Reflex save or fall Prone
Kurz.radierer: removes terrain; right-click erases with any other brush too
Kurz.aufdecken: makes terrain painted hidden visible to players; the terrain itself stays as it is

Anzeigen.Name: PF2e-ActiveTerrain: Show terrain
Anzeigen.Hint: Shows the outlines of the painted terrain. It always affects movement.

Deckkraft.Name: Advanced: Opacity of the terrain lines
Deckkraft.Hint: How visible the dashed outlines are. 100 is fully opaque, 10 barely visible.

Strichstaerke.Name: Advanced: Terrain line width
Strichstaerke.Hint: How thick the outlines are drawn. Applies to the Smooth and Simple displays.

Darstellung.Name: PF2e-ActiveTerrain: Display
Darstellung.Hint: Smooth shows the freely painted edge, simple shows the edge along the grid (easier on old computers), off shows no lines. Terrain is always calculated.

ZaehlendeFelder.Name: Advanced: Faintly shade counting squares (GM only)
ZaehlendeFelder.Hint: Shows which squares are at least half painted and therefore cost movement.

AbzeichenLage.Name: Advanced: Position of the badges at the token
AbzeichenLage.Hint: Where the boot badges for the terrain under a token are shown. Applies to this computer only.

RasterModus.Name: Advanced: Paint on the grid instead of freehand
RasterModus.Hint: Paints whole squares as up to 0.1.2, for example for rooms with straight walls.

Leiste.Verborgen: Paint hidden: what you paint now is not shown to players (it still applies)
Leiste.Werte: Area values: DC, damage and saving throw for narrow, uneven and hazardous

Werte.Gilt: Applies to everything you paint as narrow, uneven or hazardous from now on.
Werte.Leer: Empty: level-based DC for party level {stufe}, i.e. DC {sg}.

Karte.Schmal: {name} steps onto a narrow surface: Balance (Acrobatics). Off-Guard while standing on it.
Karte.Uneben: {name} steps onto uneven ground: Balance (Acrobatics). Off-Guard while standing on it.

Fehler.Speichern: PF2e-ActiveTerrain: The terrain could not be saved.

Gefahr.AufDemFeld: In the hazard's area of effect: {anzahl} creature(s).
Gefahr.Niemand: Nobody is in the hazard's area of effect.
Gefahr.BetrifftMehrere: Affects {anzahl} creatures, each rolls on its own line:
Gefahr.KeinAngriff: PF2e has no strike data for {name}.
Gefahr.KeinEntschaerfen: This hazard's Disable entry has no check.
Gefahr.ZaehltNicht: {name}: The check doesn't count, the required proficiency is missing.
Gefahr.LoestAus: {name}: Critical failure while disabling, the hazard triggers.

Magie.Keine: Detect magic by {name}: no magical hazard within 30 feet.
Magie.Da: Detect magic by {name}: magic within 30 feet ({anzahl} magical hazard(s)).
Magie.Quelle: Source of the most powerful magic: {gefahr}, narrowed to a 5-foot square, no exact location.

Magie.Name: Advanced: Detect magic reveals magical traps within 30 feet
Magie.Hinweis: By the rules, detect magic only tells whether magic is present (rank 3: its level, rank 4: roughly its source); the notice goes to the GM. When enabled, the spell also reveals hidden magical traps within 30 feet to everyone.

Bereich.Ausloeser: Trigger in feet around the trap (0 = its square only)
Bereich.Wirkung: Effect in feet around the trap (0 = its square only)
Bereich.Stand: Trigger {ausloeser} feet, effect {wirkung} feet around the trap.

Gefahr.ZuWeit: {name} is not adjacent to the hazard, the roll doesn't count.
Gefahr.NurDaneben: Only someone adjacent to the hazard counts.

Suchen.Einschalten: Start Search (exploration), {minuten} minutes of game time
Suchen.Fehlt: The Search action is missing from the PF2e compendium.
